evaluator: immutable upstream verify.main and utils.parse_measures/write_results; local path/process/output adapter
finish_summary: Implemented and froze a transistor-level two-stage fully differential OTA: NMOS folded-cascode input stage, common-source outputs, internally generated reference/cascode biases, matched 1.05 pF/500 ohm Miller networks, and continuous output CMFB with resistive/capacitive averaging. Approved-device checker passed. Final-source transient diagnostics converged across all 30 PVT points. Nominal rising/falling settling was 8.481/8.511 ns; nominal 10 ns errors were about 0.428%, and high static error was 0.00589%. The final PVT transient sweep did not meet every settling requirement: SS/1.80 V/85 C took approximately 10.249 ns and FS/1.80 V/85 C approximately 10.659 ns, with 10 ns errors approximately 1.126% and 1.348%, respectively. Final integrated noise measured 0.943 mVrms nominal, 0.994 mVrms SS/hot, and 0.896 mVrms FF/high-supply/cold. With the immediately preceding 800 fF compensation values and otherwise identical circuit, representative phase margins were 63.27/65.27/60.58 degrees, powers 7.391/7.396/8.229 mW, CM errors 4.426/5.288/7.170 mV, and differential compression ranges 1.939/1.843/2.258 V. Those loop/range measurements were not rerun after increasing compensation. A prior 1 pF-compensated revision passed the three CM pulse-recovery diagnostics, but final-source recovery was not measured. Final full-grid loop, noise and range signoff and mismatch rejection were not obtained; no claim of complete specification compliance is made.
